title: Chapter 76
text: Half palace, half barracks, but entirely a fortress, Riorson House has never been breached by army. It survived countless sieges and three full-out assaults before falling under the flame of the very dragons it existed to serve. —O N T YRRISH H ISTORY , A C OMPLETE A CCOUNTING , T HIRD E DITION BY C APTAIN F ITZGIBBONS
